subject: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, maria@peoplestrategy.co
Date: 2026-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Team —

I ran the draft timeline and a compressed approach by leadership this morning and wanted to get a short planning thread going so we can lock dates and handoff controls. High level: we propose a 3-week "review sprint" for manager reviews + calibration, followed by a 2-week compensation window. The sprint is intentionally shorter to reduce context switching for managers and align with product launch cycles in Q3.

Attachments: review_timeline_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), manager_questionnaire_v1.docx (doc), confidentiality_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Key asks:
- Markus: can you confirm leadership availability for a 90-min calibration session in week 2?
- Grace: please review the confidentiality checklist and flag any SOC-2 or data-handling obligations that change how managers store/collect notes.
- Rishi: confirm comp window constraints and any finance approval cutoff dates we need to bake in.
- Maria (PeopleStrategy): quick look at comms tone please — we want to avoid overpromising and to give managers a playbook for difficult conversations.

Proposed timeline (attached spreadsheet shows details):
- Week 0 (announce to managers & shares forms) — May 25
- Week 1 (manager writeups) — May 26–30
- Week 2 (calibration + manager edits) — June 1–5
- Week 3 (finalize ratings & signoffs) — June 8–12
- Comp window (finance approvals + offers) — June 15–26

Confidential handovers: we'll require the confidentiality_checklist.pdf to be signed by each manager before calibration. If managers need to pull in external contractors or consultants with candidate-level context, we must run vendor NDAs — tagging Rishi if approval is required.

I'll loop back with a calendar poll once we get analytics on leadership availability. Please reply with one-line confirmations so I can move to a final draft.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, maria@peoplestrategy.co
Date: 2026-05-08T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Neha —

Thanks for this clear outline. I like the sprint idea. Quick notes:
- Leadership calibration: prefer June 3 (Wednesday) 10–11:30am PT. If we do a single 90-min block we need a short pre-read (1 page) that summarizes rating distribution and focus areas; I can draft that if you want.
- Week 1 may be tight for some managers who are on call for the product launch on May 28. Can we add a 2-day buffer for overloaded teams? Suggest moving the start to May 27 and extending end by 2 days.
- For confidentiality: can we make the confidentiality checklist a mandatory upload to the private People Drive rather than email replies? Helps audit and reduces attachments floating around.

Attaching a one-pager I used last year for calibration topics (internal reference).

Markus Klein
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Neha/Markus —

Agree with Markus on the buffer. Finance has three blackout days for month-end close: May 29–31; we should avoid scheduling comp approvals over that period. That shifts our comp window start to June 15 as you proposed, which works, but we need an explicit cutoff for salary changes to be submitted by June 12 COB for payroll processing. I'll add comp-window-dates.csv with deadlines.

Regarding vendor NDAs: any external recruiter or consultant who'll see candidate-level feedback must have an executed NDA. If teams want to use the external talent partner (Maria's firm), we should route the NDA through vendor-nda@acme.com (internal vendor legal team) for rapid execution.

I'll mark finance-approval required on the Drive doc links once we finalize the timeline.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-10T10:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Thanks — I reviewed the checklist and updated a couple of items:
- Managers must not store PII (sensitive candidate feedback) in personal drives or email. The checklist now requires upload to the People Drive and flags any materials with names for redaction before wider sharing.
- Because we have incoming enterprise audits (SOC-2 re-audit Q4), we need an audit trace of who accessed manager writeups during calibration; People Drive access logs will be enabled for the calibration folder only.
- For managers who want to record voice notes, we recommend a private Teams channel with retention set to 90 days — not allowed to export recordings off-platform.

I attached an updated confidentiality_checklist.pdf and a short manager guidance doc (in Drive). I also added a short paragraph to the comms draft about framing confidentiality to employees to avoid alarm.

Grace O'Connor
Director, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, maria@peoplestrategy.co
Date: 2026-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Quick note —

I support the sprint and confidentiality flow. Two small suggestions for the manager playbook:
- Add a very short script for difficult conversations (three lines) so managers have consistent language.
- Include optional meeting templates for calibration to keep the session tight (30/60/90 minute versions).

Happy to draft those templates if folks want.

Laura Bennett
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, maria@peoplestrategy.co, vendor-nda@acme.com
Date: 2026-05-12T16:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Review sprint plan & confidential handovers — timeline, forms, comms

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps below (finalizing today):

Summary decisions:
- Sprint start: May 27 (buffers added) — manager writeups May 27–31
- Calibration: June 3, 10–11:30am PT (90-min block) — pre-read required by June 1
- Finalization: June 8–12
- Comp window: June 15–26, salary change cutoff June 12 COB
- Confidentiality: checklist must be uploaded to People Drive; People Ops will enable access logs for calibration folder

Action items:
- Markus: draft 1-page calibration pre-read (due May 20).
- Grace: publish updated confidentiality_checklist.pdf to Drive and confirm access log settings (due May 18).
- Rishi: confirm payroll processing cutoff with finance and share comp-window-dates.csv (done) and route vendor NDA with procurement (vendor-nda@acme.com).
- Laura: draft scripts/templates for manager guidance (offer 30/60/90 templates) — due May 19.
- Maria: please share a short comms paragraph (1–2 lines) for the manager announcement by EOD May 14.

I'll post a calendar poll for the calibration slot and create a folder in Drive with the final artifacts once we've closed these action items. If there are major objections, speak now — otherwise I'll consider this plan approved and will move to publish the manager announcement next week.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turn here.

Neha Kapoor
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
